description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to revoke the Order of National Development Trust Fund Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 965/6 of 04.03.1997
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the revocation of a previous order under the Trust Ordinance (Chapter 87), which is a legal/regulatory matter. It deals with statutory instruments and legal modifications (specifically revoking an earlier order that incorporated the National Development Trust Fund). While it mentions a Minister by name, this is in the context of exercising legal authority under existing legislation rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
